parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA

figures.quote: Adjusted EBITDA was $97.1 million for the quarter, up $10.7 million, or up 12.3%, from the same period in 2025, driven by both acquisition contribution and organic growth .

parsed.notes: The reconciliation table (in thousands) is cut off before the Adjusted EBITDA row, so the figure comes from the narrative text. The Q1 2025 figure is not printed. It works out to about $86.4 million ($97.1 million minus the stated $10.7 million increase), but it is left out because it is not shown directly. FY2026 guidance of $473-$483 million is a forecast, not a reported result, and is excluded.
